title: dianella revoluta var. divaricata
intro: Dianella revoluta var. divaricata, commonly known as the Flax Lily or Blue Flax Lily, is a type of flowering plant native to Australia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including skin conditions, wounds, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dianella revoluta var. divaricata include its ability to soothe and calm irritated skin, reduce inflammation, and combat microbial infections. Research on the plant has identified bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
